:::{#exm-de-morgan-intersection}
#### De Morgan's law for an intersection of die rolls

<!-- no-figure: six die faces listed element by element; the set computation is the content -->

With $S$, $A$ and $B$ as in @exm-de-morgan,

$$
\begin{aligned}
(A \cap B)^c &= \set{2}^c \\
&= \set{1, 3, 4, 5, 6},
\end{aligned}
$$

and

$$
\begin{aligned}
A^c \cup B^c &= \set{1, 3, 5} \cup \set{4, 5, 6} \\
&= \set{1, 3, 4, 5, 6},
\end{aligned}
$$

as [De Morgan's law for an intersection](#thm-de-morgan-intersection) says.

:::
